name: Abdul Hussein
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: A Finnish bantamweight (16-2, age 29) who submitted Cody Gibson in R3 in his UFC debut in July after a long UAE Warriors run.

how_they_fight.Grappling: A submission specialist: ten submissions, eight in R1.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Found the finish in R3 in his debut.

sources.title: UFC Reportedly Books Top Prospects for Massive Fight on Israel Adesanya Card
